definitions.explanation: To receive something temporarily with the intention of returning it.
To pay to use something temporarily, like an apartment or car.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}を{借|か}りてもいいですか？
{図書館|としょかん}で{本|ほん}を{借|か}りました。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from the library.
examples.notes: で marks where you borrow from

examples.japanese: アパートを{借|か}りています。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xに/からYを{借|か}りる (borrow Y from X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {借|か}りている = 'have borrowed (still have it)' or 'am renting.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{本|ほん}を{借|か}りる (borrow a book)
・{図書館|としょかん}で{借|か}りる (borrow from the library)
・アパートを{借|か}りる (rent an apartment)
・{借|か}りてもいい？ (may I borrow?)

Opposite: {貸|か}す (to lend).
